lines.zh: 两条腿走起来一晃一晃。
lines.en: Two legs, and I wobble as I go.

lines.zh: 羽毛湿了，沉得抬不起来。
lines.en: Wet feathers drag me down.
A fishy smell follows my path.
Am I walking, or drifting?

lines.zh: 脚下的爪已经不是爪了。
lines.en: What I have instead of claws is not claws.
I wander along the tideline.
Each step tilts me, head askew.

lines.zh: 我想起以前刨土的日子。
lines.en: I recall the days I scratched at soil.
Water seeps between my feathers.
I go slowly. No hurry.
This ground is so dry.
I make odd sounds as I walk.

lines.zh: 同族的叫声越来越少了。
lines.en: Fewer and fewer of my kin call.

lines.zh: 我踩下的印子是三趾的。
lines.en: My prints show three toes.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖翅膀，抖不下来什么。
lines.en: I flap; nothing shakes loose.
I shuffle toward the sea.
I stand, head twitching.
This body is light, and weak.
I can barely fly now.
The sound in my throat has changed.

lines.zh: 我在啄地上的一小块东西。
lines.en: I peck at something small.
Something moves under my feathers.
The sun is good. I bask.
I remember the taste of grain.
This leg does not obey.

lines.zh: 我眨了眨眼，眼睛有点涩。
lines.en: I blink; my eyes feel gritty.
A bug. I do not want it.

lines.zh: 我甩头，甩不掉腮边的黏液。
lines.en: I shake my head; the slime by my gills stays.
The skin on my breast has hardened.
I call out. It sounds wrong.
Did you ever feed me?

lines.zh: 我把头歪过去，认不出你。
lines.en: I tilt my head; I cannot place you.
Your hands smell of seed.

lines.zh: 我认得人，可不太记得了。
lines.en: I know people. I just cannot recall.
Do not kick me.

lines.zh: 三趾往后挪，我离你远些。
lines.en: My three toes shuffle back, away from you.
Do you still take me for a chicken?
A coo rattles in my throat.
Whose ground is this?
I stare at your shadow.

lines.zh: 伤口边上的羽毛全湿透了。
lines.en: The feathers around the wound are soaked through.

lines.zh: 嗓子挤出来的声音又尖又哑。
lines.en: The sound I squeeze out is shrill and hoarse.
I flap backward.
I tip over and push up again.
This body cannot take blows.

lines.zh: 羽毛底下的东西在抽，我抖。
lines.en: Something under my feathers twitches; I shake.

lines.zh: 细腿撑不住，抖得像筛子。
lines.en: My thin legs give out and shake like a sieve.
I tuck my head under a wing and crouch low.
Blood and water run together.

lines.zh: 气从喉管里漏出来，止不住。
lines.en: Air leaks from my throat and will not stop.
Is that grain?
I peck it. Not as good as I hoped.
I eat fast and forget the taste.
Crouch a little lower.
Ground food is easier to peck.
I swallow. My throat aches.
Scatter another handful.
I circle it.
This is not what I should eat.
I eat it anyway.
I am too light; a bump tips me.
Do not step on me. I am not whole.
I flap to right myself.

lines.zh: 一撞就散了绒毛，落了满地。
lines.en: One bump and loose down scatters everywhere.

lines.zh: 你站在我常走的那条线上。
lines.en: You are standing on the line I always walk.
The knock dizzied me.
I circle back around.

lines.zh: 你往左，我往右，各走各的。
lines.en: You go left, I go right, and we part.
My bones are brittle.
This is not my fault.

lines.zh: 我连自己是什么都不确定了。
lines.en: I am not even sure what I am.
There are fewer of my kind.

lines.zh: 喉咙里滚出两声，不像求偶。
lines.en: Two notes roll from my throat, nothing like courtship.
This is not the season.
I only want somewhere to squat.
I turn my tail to you and look away.
My body is wrong.
Do not speak of it.
I do not lay eggs anymore.
I peck at the ground.
I can carry this.
I peck it up, drop it, peck again.
Can I eat it?
I tuck it under a wing.
Too small to hold.
I drag it into the grass.
Who dropped this?

lines.zh: 我低头啄了啄，又抬头看你。
lines.en: I peck at it, then look up at you.
I will keep this for now.

lines.zh: 爪子不好用了，只能用嘴。
lines.en: My feet fail me; I use my beak.

lines.zh: 我盯着你了，虽然我不太会打。
lines.en: I fix on you, though I hardly fight.

lines.zh: 湿毛立不起来，我还是张开了翅。
lines.en: Wet feathers will not stand, but I spread my wings.
I can still peck.

lines.zh: 你一伸手，我脖子就绷直了。
lines.en: Your hand moves, and my neck goes stiff.
My cry grows shrill.
I hop once. Consider it a threat.

lines.zh: 爪子扣住地，我一步不退。
lines.en: My claws dig in; I will not give a step.
My neck stretches out.
I will go for your feet.

lines.zh: 海嗣在我喉咙里叫，不是我在叫。
lines.en: The seaborn calls from my throat, not me.

lines.zh: 我绕半圈，找你的脚后跟。
lines.en: I circle halfway round to find your heel.
I flap to look bigger.
I am poor at judging direction.
I hop, then stop.
When you move, I move.
I tilt my head to find your feet.

lines.zh: 我尖声叫着，其实怕得要命。
lines.en: I screech, though I am scared stiff.
Only two steps between us.
Something twitches under my feathers.
Stay right there.
I peck your boot.
I rake with my feet.

lines.zh: 我跳起来啄，落下时歪了。
lines.en: I leap to peck and land off balance.
I peck, and do not even break the skin.
I peck the back of your hand.
I bump your knee.
I beat my wings and raise dust.

lines.zh: 三趾的爪在你裤上划开。
lines.en: Three-toed claws rake open your trousers.
I retreat again.

lines.zh: 这已经是我全部的力气。
lines.en: That was all the strength I have.

lines.zh: 我从死去的鸡里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of a dead chicken.
Soaked, and unsteady.
I open my eyes. The world is bigger.
I try to call. The voice is wrong.

lines.zh: 我从湿羽里抖出一摊海水。
lines.en: I shake a puddle of seawater from my feathers.
The air here is so dry.
I step on grass and it makes no sound.

lines.zh: 我记得刚才还是另一副身体。
lines.en: I remember another body, moments ago.
I tilt my head at the sky.
I can stand again.
My feathers catch at once.
I hit the ground; bones click.

lines.zh: 水灌进我羽毛里，太沉了。
lines.en: Water fills my feathers. Too heavy.

lines.zh: 我被气浪掀了几个跟头。
lines.en: The blast tumbles me over and over.
An arrow passes through my wing.

lines.zh: 咒力让我身体里的东西乱动。
lines.en: Magic stirs what lives inside me.
Hunger makes me unsteady.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我羽毛全焦了。
lines.en: Lightning burns my feathers black.
No sky here, and no ground.
